name: Myzrael's Allies
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
<Myzrael speaks.>

Free!  I AM FREE!  I am free to gather strength, hidden from my captors.  For if they faced me now they would surely overpower and again imprison me.

But in time I will confront the giants, and they will regret their wardship of me!

You are a noble ally, adventurer.  I will need your help again in time.  When I am ready, I will need you to summon me to the surface

Speak with Zaruk in Hammerfall.  He knows how I can be summoned.
narrative.offerRewardText: Welcome, Champion. The Lady has informed me of your coming, and if we are to bring her back to the surface then we have much to discuss...

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 37 to 50, 23,450 XP in all.

quests.name: The Princess Trapped
quests.objectiveText: Gather 12 Motes of Myzrael, then bring them to the Iridescent Shards in Drywhisker Gorge.

quests.name: Stones of Binding
quests.objectiveText: Gather the Burning Key, the Cresting Key and the Thundering Key from the Stone of West Binding, the Stone of East Binding and the Stone of Outer Binding. Bring them to the Stone

quests.name: The Lost Fragments
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Torn Scroll Fragment, the Crumpled Scroll Fragment and the Singed Scroll Fragment to Theldurin the Lost.

quests.name: Summoning the Princess
quests.objectiveText: Go to the Shards of Myzrael, summon her and defeat her. Gather her Eldritch Shackles and bind them to the Shards of Myzrael.
